description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Beast Code develops software solutions supporting national defense missions. The Software Engineer I builds applications for these missions, working with software development technologies and implementing basic user stories, graphical user interfaces, and troubleshooting fixes.
Software Engineer I supporting actively managed, limited-complexity software projects and engineering matters

Responsibilities:
• Works on projects and matters of limited complexity in a support role where work is actively managed

Requirements:
• Can work within one or more programming language, framework or platform (i.e. Vue, C# and .NET, C++, HTML 5, CSS 3, JavaScript, TypeScript, Vite, Webpack, Python)
• Understand, and are comfortable with, the basics of SQL database
• Can implement basic user stories with minimal or no support
• Can create and modify graphical user interfaces (GUI)
• Have an analytical ability to troubleshoot and debug issues
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the proper US DoW issued security clearance, which requires US Citizenship
• maintain a valid USA driver's license

Preferred:
• Have the ability to set up a developer environment
• Familiar with GitLab
• Familiarity with Deployment technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS)
• Can identify and make architectural improvements
• Are comfortable documenting code and develop unit/regression tests
• Enjoy executing code reviews
• Can identify and utilize the appropriate framework/language for a project
• Optimize code and improve performance of applications
